claims_scope: Local fixed 80k-user whole-configuration diagnostic against the disclosed portable/corrected PR31 reference only; no official PR31 score, capacity, ranking, implementation-only attribution, or all-competitor superiority claim.
hypothesis: The W2/ARTICLE1 configuration may lower combined app+PostgreSQL CPU and latency relative to the PR31 default configuration by combining fewer database backends, live article SQL sharing, and native JSON/HMAC. This study measures the complete configurations and cannot determine the contribution of any individual difference.
clean_pair_definition: All 6 prescheduled attempts classify PASS, with zero HTTP/socket/timeout errors, valid frozen target/load/host witnesses, no target OOM and zero target swap, all 80k VUs active, and no native generator-limited verdict. Existing v3 host-memory criteria are unchanged. Invalid/failing attempts are retained and block acceptance; never replace them selectively.

metric.name: whole_target_cpu_seconds_per_successful_request
metric.scope: Combined app + PostgreSQL target cgroup, using the existing fully bracketed v3 target monitor. The CPU average uses the sampled interval inside the 60-second native request window. App-only CPU cannot substitute.
metric.limitation: CPU/request is a fixed-load sampled estimate; it does not measure maximum user capacity.

promotion_policy: A local improvement against this disclosed PR31 derivative may be claimed only if every pair passes the predeclared CPU/latency/cleanliness gates. This study cannot establish a Rust win: acceptance against Rust remains conditional on all three criteria of the separate frozen Rust study passing its completed audit. No source/default change, official rank, capacity claim, or all-competitor claim follows automatically.

candidate.json_hmac: native prepared OpenSSL HMAC and native SIMD JSON

whole_configuration_differences.attribution_limit: Any result applies to these complete frozen configurations; it cannot isolate native primitive improvements, worker count, or article batching.
